title: Myrmex Source Observation v1
description: A single immutable observation of an external backlog/source, produced by a read-only import operation. A source observation has no repository authority: the authority block pins every effect flag to false and allows only external reads. Canonical digest rules: observation_digest is the canonical SHA-256 digest of the complete observation (all fields except observation_id and observation_digest) using UTF-8, LF line endings, deterministic key ordering for structured fields, and no insignificant trailing whitespace; observation_id is 'srcobs_' + observation_digest. Outcome semantics: unchanged requires previous_content_digest to be non-null and content_digest to equal previous_content_digest; changed requires previous_content_digest to be null or content_digest to differ from previous_content_digest.

observation_digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 digest of the complete observation excluding observation_id and observation_digest.

operation_id.description: The import operation that produced this observation.

source_identity.description: Stable identity of the external source this observation came from.

adapter.description: The import adapter that read the source.

request_digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 digest of the import request that produced this observation.

previous_content_digest.description: Content digest of the previously observed state, or null when none exists.

observed_version.description: Source-reported version string when observed; null for unavailable/invalid outcomes.

content_digest.description: Canonical SHA-256 digest of the observed source content; null when no content was observed.

reason_code.description: Typed reason for unavailable/invalid/ambiguous outcomes; null for changed/unchanged.

authority.description: Bounded authority: source observation only. Only external_read is true; every effect flag is pinned false.

then.description: changed/unchanged: non-empty observed_version, 64-hex content_digest, null reason_code.
unavailable/invalid: null observed_version and content_digest, non-empty reason_code.
ambiguous: null content_digest, non-empty reason_code, observed_version string or null.
